# 1 Clement Chapter 49 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 49 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_049_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 49

*[A hymn to love — echoing 1 Corinthians 13]*

**49:1** Let the one who has love in Christ fulfill the commandments of Christ.

**49:2** Who can describe the bond of God's love? Who is able to express the greatness of its beauty?

**49:3** The height to which love lifts us is indescribable.

**49:4** Love joins us to God; love covers a multitude of sins; love bears all things, is patient in all things; nothing base is in love, nothing haughty; love knows no schism, love does not revolt, love does everything in harmony; in love all the elect of God were made perfect; without love nothing is acceptable to God.

**49:5** In love the Master took us to himself; out of the love he had for us, Jesus Christ our Lord gave his blood for us by the will of God — and his flesh for our flesh, his soul for our souls.

**49:6** You see then, beloved, how great and marvelous love is — and of its perfection there is no adequate expression.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
